name: @foritllc/auth
description: MSAL-based authentication for ForIT apps. Two high-level mode factories: createForitAuth (single-tenant, safe ForIT defaults) and createMultiTenantAuth (foreign-tenant logins, allowedTenantIds REQUIRED). 0.8.0: the id_token is validated (signature, iss, aud, exp, nonce) before tid is trusted; state + PKCE are bound to the browser by a signed transaction cookie; returnTo is same-origin only; staff = the ForIT tenant (staffPaths / isForitStaffSession), never an email domain. 0.9.0: clientAssertion redeems the code with no secret; managedIdentityClientAssertion() uses the app's managed identity through a federated credential on the shared sign-in registration. 0.10.0: defaultDeny, so every path needs a session unless it is a static asset or on publicPaths (the default from 1.0.0); static prefixes match on a path boundary; routeAccess() for route-walk tests. 0.11.0: a browser sign-out also ends the Microsoft session (Entra end-session, post_logout_redirect_uri https://<host>/, logout_hint from the id_token login_hint claim when emitted); endEntraSession: false opts out. 0.12.0: a missing, blank or unresolved Key Vault / App Configuration reference SESSION_SECRET is refused (the handler factories throw at startup, signing throws, verifying returns null), so an unresolved @Microsoft.KeyVault(...) value is never a signing key. 0.13.0: optional Google sign-in through forit-Auth's app sign-in exchange, opt-in and off by default, from the ./google subpath (createGoogleSignIn): the app holds no Google credential, its __Host-<appId>-session cookie holds only Auth's opaque handle, every request verifies with Auth and keeps nothing (fails closed), a GooglePrincipal has no tid or azureOid, and linked-principal group access is denied unless a Directory status reader (R-D2) is configured; the Entra routes, cookie and helpers are byte-for-byte unchanged. Raw createAuthMiddleware / createCallbackHandler / etc. exports kept for back-compat. Next.js entry plus a browser sub-export for Vite/SPA consumers using msal-browser.
